title: Coppa Italia winners 2001 to 2010
brief: Name the Coppa Italia winners for each year from the 2001 final to the 2010 final.

notes.Juventus: Juventus lost the final in 2002 and 2004.

checks: Every winner agrees between Wikipedia's list of finals and Transfermarkt's list of winners. 4-slot rule checked for every ten-year window from 2001: only the windows starting 2001, 2006, 2007 and 2008 pass (Inter win 4 in any window starting 2002 to 2005, Juventus win 4 or more in any window starting 2009 to 2017, so 2017 to 2026 fails too). Two windows kept: 2001 to 2010 and 2008 to 2017; they share 2008 to 2010.
